dataset.name: Pediatric acute lymphoblastic leukemia phase II (TARGET-ALL-P2)
dataset.description: Public GDC-harmonized bulk RNA-seq from TARGET acute lymphoblastic leukemia phase II with an overall-survival contract from diagnosis.
dataset.cohort_context: Pediatric acute lymphoblastic leukemia in TARGET phase II. The molecular population is restricted to primary blood-derived cancer from bone marrow or peripheral blood within TARGET-ALL-P2; phase III, recurrent and PanALL material are separate universes.
dataset.publication_citation: NCI TARGET Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia Phase II project

metadata.source_program: Therapeutically Applicable Research to Generate Effective Treatments (TARGET)
metadata.sample_selection_note: Bone marrow is preferred to peripheral blood, followed by deterministic sample, aliquot and file identifiers. One eligible RNA profile is retained per patient.
metadata.excluded_material: Recurrent blood-derived cancer and every TARGET ALL phase or aggregation other than TARGET-ALL-P2.
metadata.treatment_note: Primary blood-derived cancer is a biospecimen class, not proof of treatment-naive status. Prior treatment remains unknown when it is not documented.
metadata.endpoint_note: OS is measured from diagnosis by the GDC survival endpoint. Endpoint-incomplete expression patients remain eligible for molecular analyses but not Survival.
metadata.overlap_note: TARGET-ALL-P2 must not be pooled with TARGET-ALL-P3 or PanALL as if they were additional independent samples.

expression.label: log2(TPM + 1)
expression.mapping_source: GDC STAR-counts GENCODE v36 gene_id and gene_name fields
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Distinct Ensembl gene identifiers sharing one supplied symbol are excluded rather than merged implicitly.
expression.scale_note: The GDC STAR-counts files supply non-negative tpm_unstranded values. TRACE Explorer applies log2(TPM + 1) once.
